title: Sheriff times and tab title
body: Episode times on The Sheriff of Lone Keem match the clock on the poster. Leaving an episode puts the browser tab title back.

title: New series: The Sheriff of Lone Keem
body: A Lone Keem Studios Original, created by Keem. Follow Gecko, a lizard sheriff with an eyepatch, in a 3-episode animated western for all ages. Find it in Explore, or in Movies under Lone Keem Studios Originals.

title: A doorbell on Kemy Street
body: Soon, a friend can ring your doorbell. You will see who it is and can invite them in.

title: A shop in each game
body: Soon, Star Pool, Chess, Ludo and the other games will have a little shop of their own. Pal Zombie Survival already has the Armory.

title: You can turn on notifications
body: Want a gentle ping when it is your turn, a friend asks you to play, or someone visits your house? You choose in Settings. Each kind has its own switch, and Kemy stays quiet from 9pm to 8am.

title: Houses, garages and house radio
body: Buy a house on Kemy Street. Add a garage, park cars on the driveway, decorate your rooms, and play music on the house radio.

title: Pal Park shows up once
body: The games list on a profile used to list Pal Park twice. The extra link is gone.

title: Hats and balloons fit
body: A Pal's head, hat or balloon could get cut off on the feed, on live, and on the little floating Pal. They fit in the picture now.

title: Stuck cars can drive
body: A car could get stuck and refuse to move, because its parking spot stayed in the way. Cars drive now, and Reset flips one upright.

title: Zombie joystick on iPhone
body: The joystick in Pal Zombie Survival could freeze on an iPhone. It wakes back up if a touch gets lost.

title: Pal Zombie Survival
body: Bring your Pal and splat goofy zombies with bubbles, foam and a pillow hammer. No scary stuff. Just goo and giggles.

title: Kemy Challenge Show
body: Freeze Dash, Cookie Carve, Tug Splash, Bubble Bridge and Bumper Summit. The last Pal standing wins. Play with friends or the computer.

title: Ludo keeps going
body: If a player left while the die was rolling, Ludo could stall. The die is rolled again so the game continues.

title: Star Pool
body: Gold rails and purple felt. Sink your group, then call the 8. Play a friend or the computer.

title: Chess
body: Gold versus purple, with the real rules and an optional clock. Easy, medium or hard computer, or a friend.

title: Ludo
body: Roll the dice and race four tokens home. Two, three or four can play, including the computer.

title: Star Drop, Star Cards and more
body: Also ready to play: Star Drop, Star Cards, Checkers, KL Grid and Studio Trivia. Take turns with a friend or the computer.

title: Pal Games
body: Your Pal versus a friend in Pal Race, Bubble Pop Battle, Star Catch and Dance-Off.

title: Kemy's Bubble Quest
body: Hop, swim and blow bubbles with Kemy the axolotl.

title: Pal Park
body: Walk your Pal around a sunny 3D park with friends. Chat, dance, find treasures and jump into mini-games.
